fields.revised: revised by the orchestrator under the owner's authorization: change D1's default view so reads and slice share one rule across tasks 7 and 8. Effective change set draft or proposed -> what-if of it; accepted -> to-be; none or landed -> as-is. Work happens on accepted change sets, so the main loop stays on the fast indexed to-be path; what-if stays out of the 50 ms budget.
fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: slice [ref] + --view (Recommended): `slice <ref>` slices one node; with no ref, slices the effective change set (--change / GENESIS_CHANGE / current). --view as-is|to-be|what-if defaults to what-if when that change set is in flight, else as-is. Matches the guide's two forms and reuses the global --change.
fields.statement: `slice [ref]`: a ref gives a node slice; no ref gives a change slice of the effective change set (`--change` / `GENESIS_CHANGE` / current; none is a usage error with next `genesis slice <ref>`). `--view as-is|to-be|what-if`. Default view (amended by the owner's orchestrator on 2026-10-24, shared with task 7's reads): the effective change set is draft or proposed → what-if of it; accepted → to-be; none or landed (or any other terminal state) → as-is. A node slice with what-if needs a draft or proposed change set.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: Budget as-is/to-be only (Recommended): Use stored views for as-is and to-be (accepted change sets live there), compute what-if on demand, and put the 50 ms budget test on as-is/to-be node and change slices. Fixing what-if/catch-up refolding stays the follow-up task 5 named. Keeps this PR off task 7's index work.
fields.statement: as-is and to-be read the stored views through the index; what-if uses `index.WhatIf` and slices the resulting `model.Model`. The 50 ms budget test covers only as-is/to-be. What-if speed stays a follow-up.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: The bytes actually printed (Recommended): Same cut algorithm for both formats; the size is estimated on the markdown or the canonical JSON being output, so `slice --change X --json` itself fits 4,000 tokens (done-point 2). JSON keeps the same items as markdown at each tier.
fields.statement: The budget is measured on the bytes actually printed (markdown, or canonical JSON with `--json`), with the same cut algorithm for both. JSON keeps the same items as markdown at every tier.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: ceil(bytes / 4) (Recommended): Deterministic, cheap, the usual approximation for English and JSON; documented as an estimate. Slightly generous for text heavy with code.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: Linked to a tree root (Recommended): Only `constrains` links count: a constraint on a root capability or intent applies to everything under it, marked `from <root>`. An unlinked constraint applies nowhere. Matches the link table ("constraint → capability, intent, or a root") and keeps scope explicit.
fields.statement: Constraints apply only through `constrains` links. A constraint on a tree root applies below it, marked `from <root handle>`. An unlinked constraint applies nowhere.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: Shortest unique prefix, min 6 (Recommended): The shortest prefix (at least 6 characters) unique among the view's node IDs, so `genesis show <short>` always resolves. ULIDs made in one change set share ~10 timestamp characters, so these are often 11-13 long. Can change when a node with a close ID is added (the model changed, so the bytes may too).
fields.statement: The short ID is the shortest prefix, at least 6 characters, unique among the view's node IDs (live and retired).
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: internal/slice over a reader (Recommended): A pure package that builds and renders a slice from a small reader interface (node, ancestors, children, links, change sets); one adapter over *index.Index and one over model.Model. The api op `slice` stays thin. Lets a property test check index-built slices against model-built ones byte for byte.
fields.statement: A pure `internal/slice` package over a `Reader` interface, with adapters over `model.Model` and `*index.Index`; the api op stays thin.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: Node-op targets + link endpoints (Recommended): The nodes its node.create/update/move/retire ops target, plus the node endpoints of links it creates or retires. Each is a Focus item showing its proposed change against as-is; the other sections are the de-duplicated union.
fields.statement: A change slice touches its node-op targets plus the node endpoints of the links it creates or retires. Each touched node is a Focus item; the other sections are the de-duplicated union.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: statement + evidence status (Recommended): One-line items use `statement` (falling back to the handle). An evidence node's `status` field reads `verified` or `failing`; anything else, or no field, is `unverified`. A node's evidence status is failing > verified > unverified across its `verifies` links, `none` with no evidence. Focus shows every field.
fields.statement: Items read `statement`, falling back to the handle. An evidence node's `status` field is the JSON string `verified` or `failing`; anything else is `unverified`. A node's evidence status across live `verifies` links is failing > verified > unverified, and `none` with no evidence. Focus shows every field.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: full → brief → count, bottom-up (Recommended): Starting from section 10 and working upward (never Focus, Constraints or Open questions), shrink a section from full items (statement plus note and origin) to brief (`handle` `short` only), re-measure, then do a second pass from the bottom turning sections into counts. The footer names each shrunk section and the command to see it: `genesis tree <ref>` for children, otherwise the same slice with `--budget` set to the uncut size rounded up to the next 1,000.
fields.statement: Cuts go full → brief → count, from section 10 upward, never touching Focus, Constraints or Open questions. The footer names each shrunk section and its command: `genesis tree <ref>` for Children; anything else gets the same slice command with `--budget` set to the uncut size rounded up to the next 1,000.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.statement: TDD. Table tests in `internal/slice`; testscript goldens (markdown and `--json`: node, change, cut); a rapid property test that index-built equals model-built and that output is deterministic; a 50 ms budget test on the 50k model; `describe-golden.txtar` regenerated.

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: Live, not superseded / unanswered (Recommended): Decisions: live, reached by `decided-by` from the node or an ancestor, and not the target of a live `supersedes` from a live decision. Open questions: live, with no live `answers` from a live decision. Blocking ones (`blocks` to the node or an ancestor) come first, then ones linked by `relates-to`.
fields.statement: Current decisions: live, reached by `decided-by` from the focus or an ancestor, and not the `to` of a live `supersedes` from a live decision. Open questions: live, with no live `answers` from a live decision. Blocking first (`blocks` → focus or an ancestor), then ones linked by `relates-to` to the focus.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: depends-on both ways + relates-to; other in-flight sets (Recommended): Neighbours: live `depends-on` out (needs) and in (needed by), and `relates-to` either way with its note. In flight: every other draft, proposed or accepted change set whose ops target a Focus node, read from the index's entries; one line each: ID, state, intent.
fields.statement: Neighbours: live `depends-on` out ("needs") and in ("needed by"), and `relates-to` either way with its note. In flight: every other draft, proposed or accepted change set whose ops target a Focus node; ID, state, intent.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: Print it all, note it, exit 0 (Recommended): Those sections are never cut, so the slice is printed in full, every other section shrinks to a count, and the footer says the budget was exceeded and by how much. Exit 0: it's still the right answer.
fields.statement: When Focus, Constraints and Open questions alone exceed the budget, everything they hold is printed, every other section goes to a count, the footer says "over budget by N tokens", and the exit code is 0.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.settled_by: Agent's option, accepted by the owner: Sections of typed items (Recommended): {view, change, budget, tokens, focus:[...], context:[...], ..., omitted:[{section, count, next}]}. Each item has full id, short, handle, kind, plus tier fields (statement, note, from, status); focus items carry every field and the proposed change. Shape pinned in describe-golden as a contract.
fields.statement: JSON: `{view, change, ref, budget, tokens, over_budget, focus, context, constraints, decisions, questions, anchors, evidence, children, neighbours, in_flight, omitted}`. Items are typed: id, short, handle, kind, statement, plus note, from, status and relation where they apply. Focus items carry every field and the proposed change. `omitted` is `[{section, count, tier, next}]`. Pinned by describe-golden.
fields.wording: agent of milestone-1 task 8 (shipit plan), accepted by the owner

fields.statement: Default: a Focus item's proposed change against as-is (in to-be and what-if) is one of `new`, `retired: <reason>`, `moved: <old parent> → <new parent>`, or one line per changed field, `<field>: <as-is> → <proposed>`, each value cut to one line.
